metadata.title: Secure-Integration Platform SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan establishing the Secure-Integration Platform as the authoritative trust framework for system-to-system integrations.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits and enforces the Secure-Integration composite pattern and all constituent integration security patterns.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Secure-Integration Platform defines how trust is established, propagated, amplified, constrained, and revoked across system-to-system integrations. It governs integration eligibility, signal interpretation, lifecycle expectations, and trust revocation under Zero Trust principles.

props.name: platform-role
props.remarks: Authoritative trust plane governing all institutional system-to-system integrations.

props.name: trust-model
props.remarks: Integration trust is derived from multiple signals, continuously evaluated, and revocable.

props.name: trust-propagation
props.remarks: Trust propagation across systems is explicitly constrained and never implicit.

props.name: implicit-authorization
props.remarks: Authenticated, delivered, schema-valid, or trusted integrations do not imply business authorization.

props.name: amplification-awareness
props.remarks: Fan-out, replay, mediation, and retention are treated as amplification surfaces requiring stricter governance.

props.name: lifecycle-revocation
props.remarks: Integration trust may be degraded or revoked based on lifecycle state, posture, or aggregated signals.

system-implementation.remarks: The Secure-Integration Platform is implemented by composing independent integration security patterns that produce normalized, decision-grade trust signals. This SSPP does not perform business authorization, message enforcement, or remediation.

roles.title: Integration Security Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines Secure-Integration trust architecture, signal dependencies, and SSPP inheritance model.

roles.title: Integration Security Governance
roles.remarks: Approves integration trust policies, amplification thresholds, lifecycle rules, and risk acceptance.

roles.title: Integration Platform Operations
roles.remarks: Operates integration platforms in accordance with Secure-Integration trust and lifecycle requirements.

roles.title: Integration Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors integration trust, amplification, replay, and lifecycle signals; supports incident coordination.

control-implementation.remarks: Security and privacy controls are satisfied through inheritance from Secure-Integration patterns and downstream SSPPs. This Platform SSPP does not restate individual control implementations.
